summary: Cluster high-amplitude whole-brain coactivation events into discrete brain states by t-SNE-embedding the event × region matrix and running HDBSCAN on the 2-D embedding, reassigning every HDBSCAN noise point to its best-correlating cluster centroid, relabelling clusters by size, and rendering the event × event Pearson correlation matrix sorted by cluster to expose block-diagonal structure.
use_when: Run the Brain state clustering of high-amplitude coactivation events recipe

Cluster high-amplitude whole-brain coactivation events into discrete brain states by t-SNE-embedding the event × region matrix and running HDBSCAN on the 2-D embedding, reassigning every HDBSCAN noise point to its best-correlating cluster centroid, relabelling clusters by size, and rendering the event × event Pearson correlation matrix sorted by cluster to expose block-diagonal structure.
avoid_when: The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
